question.prompt: A makes \(x\) items per day, and B makes 2 more items per day than A. A takes the same amount of time to make 60 items as B takes to make 80 items. Find \(x\).

solutions.explanation: Set up the equation \(\frac{60}{x}=\frac{80}{x+2}\). Clearing the denominators gives \(60(x+2)=80x\), so \(x=6\). Checking confirms that it satisfies the conditions of the problem.
solutions.title: Equate production times

solutions.explanation: Over the same duration, B makes \(80-60=20\) more items because B makes 2 more items each day. Thus the common duration is \(20\div2=10\) days. A therefore makes \(x=60\div10=6\) items per day. B makes 8 items per day, consistent with making 80 items in those 10 days.
solutions.title: Find the common duration
